range_decision.evidence: The displacement trajectories for N, E, and U components exhibit continuous physical motion characterized by a gradual upward trend in the E and U axes starting around index 450. While there are isolated spikes (e.g., N at ~486) and abrupt changes in slope or level (e.g., N dropping at ~547), these do not form the pattern of a temporary observation offset. Specifically, there is no instance where all three components shift abruptly to a sustained plateau and subsequently return across the same axes. The observed steps appear permanent or part of the underlying deformation signal.
